name: Miyagawa Taeko
source:
A high-flying lady. She is highly educated and has a harsh manner. 

She worked as a general manager of a listed company until she was 30 years old.  She has a commanding and cold tone, but in fact she is kind and devoted.  She is also a sexually devoted person. This is her first child birth.
